nota: Natural events with advance warning. The Moon has no weather: these are the real equivalent phenomena (data outside the challenge's official list, simplified for the game).

llamarada_solar.texto_aviso: Particles from a solar flare arrive in {t} s. Shelter in the habitat or wear the Regolith shield.
llamarada_solar.texto_activo: SOLAR FLARE! Outside you take radiation.
llamarada_solar.realismo: Solar particle storms are a real radiation risk beyond Earth.

eclipse.texto_aviso: Earth will block the Sun in {t} s: extreme cold and no solar power.
eclipse.texto_activo: ECLIPSE: panels don't generate and the temperature drops.
eclipse.realismo: From the Moon, a lunar eclipse looks like Earth covering the Sun: the surface cools within minutes.

meteoritos.texto_aviso: Micrometeorite shower in {t} s in the marked zone. Get away!
meteoritos.realismo: With no atmosphere, micrometeorites reach the lunar surface at high speed.

pico_termico.texto_aviso: Lunar noon in {t} s: sunlit ground gets extremely hot.
pico_termico.texto_activo: HEAT PEAK: outside the shade you overheat.
pico_termico.realismo: In sunlight the lunar surface exceeds 100 °C; in shadow it drops below −150 °C.
